verdict.rationale: Twenty documents its own deletion capabilities: batch delete of records through the REST/GraphQL APIs and schema-level deletion of objects and fields via the Metadata API. Its self-hosting option is positioned for privacy-conscious organizations that need to own their data end to end. Data export and filtering which emails get imported support data control, but there is no documented retention-policy feature. missing for 10: configurable retention periods or automatic purge policies, documented account- or workspace-level deletion or erasure workflows, controls over how long AI and chat data is retained, independent corroboration.
